baseline: Real frozen combined-weighted-v1 production policy, including market overrides

prior.update: Predict every event on a day, then incorporate that day's outcomes. Global and local counts never use the target day.

selection.accuracy: Reject development hit regressions, maximize validation hits; ties prefer production, then development hits, then label.
selection.probability: Reject development log-loss regressions, minimize validation log loss; ties prefer production, then label.
selection.freeze: Write and SHA-256 hash selection.json before calculating evaluation-block metrics. The protocol records the executed study, not a prospective preregistration.

evaluation.status: Every block was already examined in earlier studies. These are retrospective diagnostic comparisons, not untouched holdouts.

statistical_limits: Inherited paired tests and day-bootstrap intervals are descriptive. No significance claim after candidate selection or repeated historical reuse. Uniform rankings depend on panel-order tie breaking and offer no discovered predictive signal.
